title: Keep findings from different overworld regions in separate QA clusters
body:
The feedback location index produces region-level overworld locations with a canonical region name and null node/scene/quest identifiers. `locationKey` in src/feedback/cluster.ts omits region on the assumption that it is redundant with node. For region-level findings, all of its included identifiers are null, so different known regions receive the same key.

Matching or similar issue text from different regions can therefore enter one cluster. When different provider families contribute those reports, QA can treat reports about separate places as corroboration of one defect. The raw location union does not repair the lost identity; the cluster keeps one region field.

The QA location label also omits the known region and falls back to one reporter's raw spelling. Region-level tickets should use the canonical region label.

Add a region discriminator only when the overworld location has no node. Preserve existing node and quest identities, exact/fuzzy matching rules, the similarity threshold, and unresolved-location isolation. Prove different-region separation and same-region merging through triage, including the promotion result. Add a bug trace and run focused QA/feedback tests, pre/post crawler, integrity checks, independent review, and the required health:fast bar before landing.
